quotes.text: Refund payments made with bank transfers, or refund a customer's available cash balance.
Customers have 45 days from receipt of the request to submit bank account details.
A refund to the customer cash balance succeeds immediately.
You can only cancel un-processed refunds.
Stripe doesn’t support refunds for international (SWIFT) payments

Refund is in `requires_action` 45 days after creation
A refund to the customer cash balance succeeds immediately.
If the customer has submitted their bank account details, the refund transitions to `pending`.
After the customer submits their bank account details, you can’t cancel a refund.
Stripe doesn’t support refunds for international (SWIFT) payments

findings: New raw lines 5-257 and old raw lines 4-270 describe the same bank-transfer/customer-cash-balance refund procedures and outcome states. Diff lines 1-315 show Node-to-curl sample changes, CDN image URLs, step numbering, table padding, and a retrieval link/wording refresh; these do not establish a new refund capability or deadline.

Current source lines 4-7 and 44-46 contain only the 2026-05-05 old raw provenance. Add the 2026-11-07 full capture while retaining the older local-image-backed record and dated Node sample context. Source frontmatter lines 1-9 also lack the canonical_url field; bind it to the trusted https://docs.stripe.com/payments/customer-balance/refunding URL while preserving both May and November raw links (old/new raw lines 1-2).

The guide distinguishes bank-transfer payment refund to a bank account (new raw lines 11-58; old raw lines 10-61), bank-transfer payment refund to customer cash balance (new raw lines 84-93; old raw lines 91-100), and available cash-balance return to customer bank (new raw lines 95-124; old raw lines 102-135). It separately covers cancellation of a bank refund before details arrive (new raw lines 60-82) and cancellation of an unprocessed cash-balance return through Dashboard only (new raw lines 126-139). Current source lines 13,17-21 call these four flows and omit the second cancellation as a distinct procedure.

For the payment-to-bank path, new raw lines 13-21 require a destination bank account; Stripe may know it, otherwise requests it by customer email or overridden instructions_email. A missing customer email can make creation fail. Payment refund must be created within 180 days, and each refund including partial refunds may incur a fee (new raw lines 15,21,58). This does not apply the fee to the immediate/free payment-to-cash-balance path (new raw lines 84-93).

New raw lines 41-56 and old raw lines 44-59 show payment-to-bank refund status requires_action at creation, pending after details, succeeded after successful payout, requires_action again after bank return, failed/refund.failed after timeout, or canceled before processing. Current source lines 23-32 present that table without path scope, even though payment-to-cash-balance succeeds immediately at new raw line 86 and old raw line 93.

The source line 20 claims a refunds.create({payment_intent,destination:'customer_balance'}) API request for payment-to-cash-balance, but both pinned guides provide only the Dashboard Destination selection for that path (new raw lines 84-93; old raw lines 91-100). The API example with origin:'customer_balance' is for the opposite cash-balance-to-bank flow (new raw lines 112-124; old raw lines 119-135). Do not present the destination parameter as established by these captures without separately read authority.

New raw lines 19 and 54, echoed by old raw lines 18 and 57, have an internal tension at 45 days: one says funds return to customer cash balance and contact customer for alternative return, the other says refund.failed and funds must be returned outside Stripe. The status table new raw line 49 also measures 45 days after creation while prose line 19 measures from receipt of request. Preserve these as unresolved wording discrepancies, not a resolved operational clock or money destination.

New raw lines 126-139 limit cash-balance-return cancellation to unprocessed refunds through the Dashboard and credit the amount back to available cash balance. The payment refund cancellation API uses POST /v1/refunds/{id}/cancel (new raw lines 72-82), while old raw lines 75-89 show a Node method sample; the two refund origins and cancellation surfaces must stay distinct.

New raw lines 141-155 and old raw lines 152-166 identify instructions_email and next_action.display_details.email_sent for bank-detail request tracking; pending is processing, succeeded is successful payout. New raw lines 157-170 and old raw lines 168-181 exclude automatic SWIFT refunds and automated emails, giving a manual return path, with sandbox emails only to Stripe-account-linked addresses.

Related concepts wiki/concepts/stripe-bank-transfers.md lines 69-80,136-142 and wiki/concepts/stripe-customer-balance.md lines 53-63,73-82 distinguish refund path and ledger transaction types; the bank-transfers concept already routes to this source. Any reciprocal clarification should preserve cash balance versus invoice balance and not imply a Refund object is paid when it is only requires_action.

answers.Q1: At https://docs.stripe.com/payments/customer-balance/refunding, new raw lines 5-58,60-139 and 141-170 document refunding a bank-transfer PaymentIntent to a customer bank, refunding that payment immediately to the Customer cash balance, and returning available cash balance to a bank, with separate cancellation surfaces. Compared with old raw lines 4-61,63-150 and 152-181, the procedures and state boundaries remain essentially stable: bank-directed refunds can require details, then be pending, succeeded, returned to requires_action, failed or canceled; immediate cash-balance credit is different. source-stripe-bank-transfers-refunds.md summarizes the routes but applies the bank-status table too broadly and cites an API destination request not shown by either pinned guide. For the payment-to-bank route, Stripe needs a destination bank account or requests details through the Customer email or instructions_email; a missing Customer email can make refund creation fail, and the payment refund must be created within 180 days (new raw lines 11-21; old raw lines 10-20). These prerequisites and bank-directed payout states differ from immediate payment-to-cash-balance credit and from returning available cash balance to a bank with origin: customer_balance (new raw lines 84-124; old raw lines 91-135).
answers.Q2: For https://docs.stripe.com/payments/customer-balance/refunding, new raw lines 30-39,72-82,112-124 and 166-257 mainly recast old raw lines 29-42,75-89,119-135 and 177-270 into curl, refreshed images and formatting; no substantive refund behavior change is established. source-stripe-bank-transfers-refunds.md should retain dated 180-day, 45-day, email, SWIFT and sandbox qualifications, but separate payment-to-bank, immediate payment-to-cash-balance, cash-balance-to-bank and their two cancellations. The captured page conflicts internally: new raw line 19 starts 45 days at request receipt and returns funds to cash balance, while lines 49 and 54 measure from creation and call for return outside Stripe. A created Refund or pending transfer does not establish customer receipt; only succeeded marks successful payout.
